dataset.description: All twelve original datasets are required; TUEG pretraining is a distinct input. Author confirms TUAB3.0.1 and TUEV2.0.0; PhysioNet source names EEGMMI1.0.0. Exact participant-to-file mapping and exclusions remain incomplete; overlapping clinical case IDs cannot be presumed independent people.

split.description: Retain each original paper split, including within-person trial splits for SEED-V/BCIC2020-3 and original participant splits elsewhere. PhysioNet specifies1-70/71-89/90-109, but code slices an unfiltered sorted staging directory. TUAB/TUEV historical comparison split identities are explicitly unrecovered; deterministic June2025 splits or universal person-held-out splits are different conditions.

inputs.description: Source-defined EEG channels, epoch durations and context, original supervision budget and declared pretrained TUEG/model access. ISRUC uses20 successive30-second epochs; preserving sequence context is part of the input. A30%-label condition cannot replace original full-label results.

preprocessing.description: Bind each original dataset recipe to its original cohort and code revision: source uses200Hz one-second patches with task-specific filtering, channels and windowing. PhysioNet preprocessing is directly inspected, but paper/source disagreements and full twelve-dataset native parity remain unresolved; silently correcting staging or sequence joins would change the task.

metric.description: Original panel: balanced accuracy, Cohen kappa and weighted F1 for multiclass; balanced accuracy, PR area and ROC area for binary; Pearson correlation, R2 and RMSE for vigilance regression. Higher is better except RMSE. Balanced accuracy is mean class recall; kappa=(observed agreement-chance agreement)/(1-chance agreement); weighted F1 uses class support. No source-defined scalar over heterogeneous datasets exists. Native binary decisions use sigmoid(logit)>0.5; PR area is trapezoidal auc(recall,precision), not average precision. R2=1-SSE/SST and RMSE=sqrt(mean squared error); Pearson uses np.corrcoef. Exact undefined-class and ISRUC sequence handling require runtime qualification.

aggregation.description: Paper reports mean and standard deviation across five random seeds per dataset, without a single cross-dataset score. Exact five seed identities and SD denominator remain unbound. Subject/trial aggregation and original support must be recovered per endpoint before combining evidence.

full_panel.description: Retain all12original datasets and central model/metric/control program required by the unchanged current task. Tables2,3,7-14 contain128dataset-method rows, including ISRUC DeepSleepNet/USleep and TUAB/TUEV LaBraM-Large/Huge plus excluding-target-pretraining CBraMod; their768printed mean/SD scalars are recovered. Table4 supplies clean/dirty/no pretraining controls on FACED,SEED-V,PhysioNet-MI,SHU-MI:72printed scalars,24standard-referencealiases and48additional findings. In total816real nonduplicate source findings are declared. Figure4 attention(full/axial/CCNet/native dual) and Figure5 positional encoding(none/absolute/conditional/asymmetric conditional) are indispensable central companions; their exact numerical panels remain unrecovered. Per-observation/run outputs, authentic source identities and independently justified criteria remain unqualified. Additional Tables15-23 and Figures6-13 are retained only as external source inventory; availability does not make the13thBCICdataset,LOSO,low-label,scaling,masking,parameter/FLOP or representation/convergence experiments newly mandatory. No heterogeneous aggregate or null-placeholder expansion is admitted.

permitted_observations.description: Use the original task-specific EEG, supervision, training/development labels and declared TUEG pretraining resources, preserving source within-person trial splits for SEED-V/BCIC2020-3 and original person/case splits elsewhere. Predictions must be frozen before operator target scoring. Source test labels and exposure remain an operator provenance issue, not newly secret data. Preserve200Hz one-second patches, task channels/durations/normalization, and ISRUC20successive30-second epochs with original sequence IDs. A future paired paper+data/paper+data+author-code protocol must share authentic data, cohorts, splits, observations, evaluation and cumulative budgets; only the pinned author code is added. Printed paper values may be supplied but cannot count as computed predictions. Current role projections do not establish immutable observation/access manifests or original release/pretraining overlap; the universal person-held-out30%-label extension is not the original condition.
